static devDept.Geometry.Transformation GetKinematicProbeTransformation (Point3D targetPoint, Vector3D surfaceNormal, double reach, double headPivotOffset)
 Computes the probe arm transformation for kinematic CMM probes. Rotates the probe arm around the head knuckle pivot point so the tip lands at targetPoint and the arm is orbitally offset along the probe direction.
static devDept.Geometry.Transformation GetKinematicHeadTransformation (Point3D targetPoint, Vector3D surfaceNormal, double reach, double headPivotOffset)
 Computes the CMM head transformation for kinematic CMM probes. The head remains strictly vertical along the CMM quill (Z-axis), centered at the knuckle pivot, and rotates in yaw (B angle) around the quill.

Mesh? BuildProbeWorldMeshForSample (ProbeCollisionSceneSnapshot scene, ProbeCollisionSample sample, string toolBlockName)
 Builds the probe/tool mesh tessellated and transformed into world space at the given sample's point/normal/up, on the calling (UI) thread. This MUST run on the UI thread - GetEntityMesh refuses to tessellate Brep/Mesh geometry off the UI thread because Eyeshot's mesh conversion touches structures that are not safe to use from a background thread. The returned mesh is a plain in-memory Mesh (no Eyeshot control affinity), so once built it is safe to hand to the background collision worker for the actual point-in-solid test.

bool DetectCollisionEyeshot (Entity entity1, Entity entity2, BlockKeyedCollection blocks, bool firstOnly=true)
 Detects collision between two entities using solid mesh intersection. Performs a two-phase check: fast AABB pre-filter, then precise mesh triangle intersection. Uses the actual solid geometry rather than convex hull or simplified bounding box.
bool DetectCollisionAgainstWorldMesh (Mesh probeWorldMesh, Entity entity2, BlockKeyedCollection blocks)
 Same two-phase (AABB pre-filter + solid mesh) collision test as DetectCollisionEyeshot, but takes an already-built, already-world-transformed Mesh for the probe/tool side instead of an Entity. Used by the probe collision background worker: the probe mesh is built once per sample on the UI thread (BuildProbeWorldMeshForSample) since Eyeshot mesh extraction is not safe off the UI thread, then this method - which only does thread-safe geometric math (bounding boxes, ray/triangle intersection) - can run on the worker thread. The part side (entity2) still resolves through GetEntityMesh's cache, which is safe here because the part meshes were pre-cached on the UI thread in BuildProbeCollisionSceneSnapshot.
bool CheckSolidMeshCollision (Entity entity1, Entity entity2, BlockKeyedCollection blocks, double tolerance)
 Performs precise collision detection using actual solid mesh geometry. Checks if any vertices or triangles of entity1 intersect with entity2's solid.
bool CheckSolidMeshCollisionCore (Mesh mesh1, Mesh mesh2, Point3D? mesh2BoxMinHint, Point3D? mesh2BoxMaxHint, double tolerance)
 Mesh-to-mesh core of the solid collision test, shared by both DetectCollisionEyeshot (Entity-based, e.g. path-planning collision checks) and DetectCollisionAgainstWorldMesh (pre-built world-space Mesh, used by the probe collision background worker). Contains only thread-safe geometric math - no Eyeshot entity/mesh extraction - so it is safe to call from a background thread as long as both meshes were already built on the UI thread.

Descrição detalhada

Path manager for CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) with visualization, simulation and path generation capabilities. Handles the generation, visualization, and simulation of inspection paths for 3D CAD models.

◆ BuildProbeWorldMeshForSample()

Mesh? HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.BuildProbeWorldMeshForSample ( ProbeCollisionSceneSnapshot scene,
ProbeCollisionSample sample,
string toolBlockName )
private

Builds the probe/tool mesh tessellated and transformed into world space at the given sample's point/normal/up, on the calling (UI) thread. This MUST run on the UI thread - GetEntityMesh refuses to tessellate Brep/Mesh geometry off the UI thread because Eyeshot's mesh conversion touches structures that are not safe to use from a background thread. The returned mesh is a plain in-memory Mesh (no Eyeshot control affinity), so once built it is safe to hand to the background collision worker for the actual point-in-solid test.

◆ CheckSolidMeshCollisionCore()

bool HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.CheckSolidMeshCollisionCore ( Mesh mesh1,
Mesh mesh2,
Point3D? mesh2BoxMinHint,
Point3D? mesh2BoxMaxHint,
double tolerance )
private

Mesh-to-mesh core of the solid collision test, shared by both DetectCollisionEyeshot (Entity-based, e.g. path-planning collision checks) and DetectCollisionAgainstWorldMesh (pre-built world-space Mesh, used by the probe collision background worker). Contains only thread-safe geometric math - no Eyeshot entity/mesh extraction - so it is safe to call from a background thread as long as both meshes were already built on the UI thread.

Parâmetros
mesh1First mesh (typically the probe/tool), already in world space
mesh2Second mesh (typically the part), already in world space
mesh2BoxMinHintOptional precomputed bounding box min for mesh2 (avoids a re-scan)
mesh2BoxMaxHintOptional precomputed bounding box max for mesh2
toleranceCollision tolerance in mm

◆ DetectCollisionAgainstWorldMesh()

bool HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.DetectCollisionAgainstWorldMesh ( Mesh probeWorldMesh,
Entity entity2,
BlockKeyedCollection blocks )
private

Same two-phase (AABB pre-filter + solid mesh) collision test as DetectCollisionEyeshot, but takes an already-built, already-world-transformed Mesh for the probe/tool side instead of an Entity. Used by the probe collision background worker: the probe mesh is built once per sample on the UI thread (BuildProbeWorldMeshForSample) since Eyeshot mesh extraction is not safe off the UI thread, then this method - which only does thread-safe geometric math (bounding boxes, ray/triangle intersection) - can run on the worker thread. The part side (entity2) still resolves through GetEntityMesh's cache, which is safe here because the part meshes were pre-cached on the UI thread in BuildProbeCollisionSceneSnapshot.

Definido na linha 21456 do ficheiro PathManager.cs.

Referências _filterConfig, CheckSolidMeshCollisionCore() e GetEntityMesh().

Entity entity2,
BlockKeyedCollection blocks,
bool firstOnly = true )
private

Detects collision between two entities using solid mesh intersection. Performs a two-phase check: fast AABB pre-filter, then precise mesh triangle intersection. Uses the actual solid geometry rather than convex hull or simplified bounding box.

entity2Second entity (e.g. part)

◆ OrderPointsWithFeatureClusters()

List< PathPoint > HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.OrderPointsWithFeatureClusters ( List< PathPoint > points)
private

Orders points by first clustering them per face (feature), then sequencing features by proximity, and finally ordering points within each feature. This approximates an ACFG-style feature graph while reusing the existing nearest-neighbor heuristic for local ordering.

void HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.RebuildInPathBridges ( HashSet< Color >? movedColors = null)
private

Rebuilds bridge segments that are embedded mid-path (when multiple parts share a single ColorPath, i.e. same scan color). After a part move, non-bridge points are translated but the old bridge points retain stale positions; this method removes them and re-interpolates new bridges between the adjacent non-bridge runs.

◆ TryGetTransformedBox()

bool HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.TryGetTransformedBox ( devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform,
Point3D localMin,
Point3D localMax,
double margin,
out Point3D? worldMin,
out Point3D? worldMax )
staticprivate

Cheaply derives a world-space AABB for a mesh given its LOCAL-frame AABB and a transform, by transforming only the 8 box corners rather than transforming and re-traversing the full mesh (which is what Mesh.UpdateBoundingBox would otherwise cost on every sample). Used to pre-filter which parts a transformed probe tool could plausibly touch before running expensive exact collision detection against them.
